$comment: Workstream R Batch-0 reality audit (new15 §6.3). The served static tree, ENUMERATED FROM `git ls-files` — committed bytes, not a bake, not a directory walk. §6.3 says "Do not infer from code": a fresh bake would silently exclude committed-but-no-longer-emitted files and include untracked output, and either error would be invisible in the counts. Every entry carries its producer. `.well-known/security.txt` is marked FOREIGN because CallLint does not produce it and the repo deliberately disowns it; an audit that claimed authorship would license a later batch to regenerate or delete a file that is not ours.
batch: new15 Workstream R / Batch 0 / PR R-0

cleaningBehavior.install: bake.ts rmSync(join(publicRoot,'install')) — CallLint owns the whole tree, so a de-listed resource's page disappears
cleaningBehavior..well-known: NOT wholesale-cleaned, by design — bake.ts:140 states the reason is the foreign security.txt

eolPin..gitattributes: apps/web/public/** and artifacts/adoption-index-v1/** are pinned text eol=lf
eolPin.why: a CRLF checkout false-fails byte-comparison gates on windows-latest alone, invisible to ci:local

files.note: calllint.discovery.v1, rendered by renderDiscoveryManifest.ts and emitted at the SITE root.
NOT produced by CallLint. .gitattributes pins .well-known narrowly so a foreign security.txt is untouched, and bake.ts does not wholesale-clean the directory for the same reason.
